snippet.title: LSDos Gameplay Trailer (Coming to Steam!!)
snippet.description: If you're confused, yes, the game's title has been changed from MS_Dos to LSDos. This is because Steam will automatically flag the title, and it would bring the attention of the absolutely benevolent Microsoft Corporation.
